                  - text: This is the main source code repository for
                  - link "Rust" [ref=f126e832] [cursor=pointer]:
                    - /url: https://www.rust-lang.org/
                  - text: . It contains the compiler, standard library, and documentation.
                - generic [ref=f126e833]:
                  - heading "Why Rust?" [level=2] [ref=f126e834]
                  - 'link "Permalink: Why Rust?" [ref=f126e835] [cursor=pointer]':
                    - /url: "#why-rust"
                - list [ref=f126e838]:
                  - listitem [ref=f126e839]:
                    - paragraph [ref=f126e840]:
                      - strong [ref=f126e841]: "Performance:"
                      - text: Fast and memory-efficient, suitable for critical services, embedded devices, and easily integrated with other languages.
                  - listitem [ref=f126e842]:
                    - paragraph [ref=f126e843]:
                      - strong [ref=f126e844]: "Reliability:"
                      - text: Our rich type system and ownership model ensure memory and thread safety, reducing bugs at compile-time.
                  - listitem [ref=f126e845]:
                    - paragraph [ref=f126e846]:
                      - strong [ref=f126e847]: "Productivity:"
                      - text: Comprehensive documentation, a compiler committed to providing great diagnostics, and advanced tooling including package manager and build tool (
                      - link "Cargo" [ref=f126e848] [cursor=pointer]:
                        - /url: https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo
                      - text: ), auto-formatter (
                      - link "rustfmt" [ref=f126e849] [cursor=pointer]:
                        - /url: https://github.com/rust-lang/rustfmt
                      - text: ), linter (
                      - link "Clippy" [ref=f126e850] [cursor=pointer]:
                        - /url: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-clippy
                      - text: ) and editor support (
                      - link "rust-analyzer" [ref=f126e851] [cursor=pointer]:
                        - /url: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer
                      - text: ).
